newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends marginally up, trade cautious.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends marginally up, trade cautious.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices moved up on technical support among nearby futures. Some buying appeared when April futures broke the 1,300 ringgit level. There were also a lot of pre-holiday switching of positions.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures, with interest centred among nearby crude palm oil ahead of the approaching festive holidays.
Cargo surveyors Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) and Caleb Brett on Friday estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for January at 586,046 and 616,372 tonnes respectively.
European palm oil traders, however, were sceptical about the figures, saying they were higher than expected.
"If SGS can give a breakdown of palm oil imports from all the destinations in black and white, we can't doubt the data and have to accept it," a trader said.
Local traders had earlier speculated exports at around 580,000 tonnes.
Some buying emerged when April futures broke the 1,300 ringgit level. At the close, the contract was six ringgit higher at 1,302 ringgit ($524.36) a tonne.
Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,347.50 ringgit against bids of 1,345, after trading at 1,342.50.
Feb (central) was offered at 1,347.50 and bids at 1,342.50 with early trades at 1,340. Feb (north) was offered at 1,342.50 against 1,335.
Mar (south) saw offers at 1,345 with bids at 1,340, with early trades at 1,337.50 and 1,340. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,345 against bids at 1,340.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $567.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Mar at $562.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $552.50.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $597.50, Mar at $595 and Apr/May/Jun at $585.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $465 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50.
